values./system/description:
A makeshift weapon created by enterprising engineers in the wastelands, the railway rifle uses high-pressure steam to propel railway spikes at speeds sufficient to pierce and impale a wide range of targets.

A Railway Rifle can accept one each of the following mods:

  • Receiver: Automatic Piston
  • Barrel: Long Barrel
  • Stock: Recoil-Compensating Stock
  • Sights: Reflex Sight, Short Scope, Long Scope, Short Night Vision Scope, Long Night Vision Scope, Recon Scope
  • Muzzle: Bayonet
